## Description

Briefly describe the change, motivation, and solution.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring or code quality improvement

## Platform Tested

- [ ] Linux (X11)
- [ ] Linux (Wayland)
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Other / Not platform-specific

## Checklist

- [ ] My code compiles cleanly without warnings (`cargo check`)
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`cargo test`)
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality or bug fixes
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (README.md, config.example.toml, etc.)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
